properties.optionsSql: SELECT CAST(CustomerId AS nvarchar(20)) AS Value, CompanyName AS Label FROM dbo.MF_Demo_Customers WHERE IsActive = 1 ORDER BY CompanyName

SELECT CAST(OrderId AS nvarchar(20)) AS Value, CONCAT(OrderNumber, ' - ', Status) AS Label FROM dbo.MF_Demo_Orders WHERE CustomerId = TRY_CONVERT(int, NULLIF(:customer_id, '')) ORDER BY OrderDate DESC, OrderId DESC

settings.successMessage: Your order request has been recorded.

databaseInsert.insertSql: INSERT INTO dbo.MF_Demo_OrderRequests (OrderId, ContactEmail, RequestType, Notes) VALUES (TRY_CONVERT(int, :order_id), :contact_email, :request_type, :notes);

_template.name: SQL Customer and Order Cascade
_template.description: Reads customers and their related orders from SQL Server, reloads the Order dropdown when Customer changes, and inserts the submitted request into an application-owned table.
